research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: www.bni.co.id (Imperva/Incapsula JS challenge) and www.idx.co.id (Cloudflare challenge) both block automated clients; no challenge was bypassed. Every BNI document was downloaded from Internet Archive (web.archive.org) snapshots of the exact bni.co.id URLs stored in source_url. Snapshot timestamps: AR2025 20260518165642; AR2024 20250711144506; AR2023 20250215195108; AR2022 20230327202127; AR2021 20220303083607; AR2020 20210612160450; FS2024 20250126070651; FS2023 20250127052402; FS2022 20230323013824; FS2021 20220303083714; FS2020 20210512035636; FS2019 20210512035657; FY24 deck 20250515172517; 1H2026 published FS 20261019060134; dividend notices FY2020 20210613111231, FY2021 20221222111733, FY2022 20230803041819, FY2024 20250515092308. URL form: https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<source_url>.
STOCK SPLIT DATE: the 1:2 split took effect on 2023-10-06 (first regular-market session at the new nominal value), not in 2024. Source: AR2023 p. 29 schedule; AR2025 repeats it.

SHARE_BASIS: for FY figures from audited FS/AR share tables, share_basis = the period-end/price date. That is a date on which the printed figure and the share count were on the same basis, checked with eps x shares_out = profit. FY2020-FY2022 EPS, shares, prices and DPS are pre-split, so the adjuster divides them by 2. BNI never restated pre-split EPS: the FY2023 FS comparative and the AR2024/AR2025 highlight tables still print FY2022 EPS 983 and FY2021 585. The AR2024/AR2025 dividend-history tables MIX bases: FY2022 DPS is printed split-adjusted (196.4), while FY2021 (146.3) and FY2020 (44.0) are printed as paid. All DPS were therefore taken from the original announcements, with share_basis = announcement date.

FY2020/FY2019 SCOPE: both years consolidate BNI Syariah, which merged into Bank Syariah Indonesia on 1 Feb 2021 and was deconsolidated in FY2021. FY2020 loans include sharia financing. Temporary syirkah deposits (2020: 31,880.7; 2019: 31,770.3 IDR bn) sit outside 'deposits from customers' and are NOT included in fy.*.deposits. AR2024 shows pro-forma ex-BNI Syariah 2020 figures (TA 839,910; loans 553,106; deposits 631,551). Growth 2020->2021 is therefore distorted by deconsolidation.

RESTATEMENTS: AR2025 restates FY2024 (and the 1 Jan 2024 opening balance) for PSAK 117 insurance contracts. FY2024 restated: TA 1,130,128.862; equity_attr 162,071.240; total equity 166,548.007. Profit attributable is unchanged at 21,463.599. fy.2024 and fy.2023 store the figures as originally reported in their own audited FS; restated values are given in the notes.

RATIO BASIS: all FY ratios are bank-only as printed in the AR 'Financial Ratios (Bank Only)' table: AR2025 for FY2021-FY2025, AR2024 for FY2020. These values were cross-checked against AR2020/AR2021/AR2022 and no definition changes were found. ROE stored = 'ROE - Tier 1 Capital Based' (OJK), the same definition as the interim OJK ratio; the equity-based ROE is quoted in each note. CoC FY2020-FY2024 comes from the FY2024 analyst deck (bank-only, consistent with each year's own deck). FY2025 CoC is null.

INTERIM: 9M2026 results were published on 2026-10-27; news reports net profit of about Rp16.1tn (+6.6% YoY), loans +22.2% YoY and quarterly NIM of about 3.3%. Neither the 9M2026 statement nor the presentation could be retrieved, so `interim` uses the reviewed H1 2026 published statement (filing). Interim equity_attr follows the OJK published format: about Rp2,257bn lower than the PSAK definition used for fy.*. Re-run when the 9M2026 documents become retrievable.

DIVIDENDS: there were no interim or special dividends out of FY2020-FY2025 profit. Each year's statement of changes in equity shows exactly one payment, equal to the prior-year final: 820.1 / 2,724.6 / 7,324.8 / 10,454.7 / 13,951.3, plus 13,026.5 in H1 2026. FY2026 interim: none announced as of BNI's public expose of 9 Sep 2026 (management said it was still under review; news), and no later announcement was found. Only the FY2025 final relies on news, for DPS and dates; its total is corroborated by the 1H2026 filing.

TREASURY SHARES / BUYBACKS: treasury shares at FY end were 19,579,700 (2020), 24,682,600 (2021), 0 (2022), 40,514,600 (2023), 0 (2024) and 0 (2025). The AGMS of 9 Mar 2026 approved a buyback of up to Rp905.48bn (news). The H1 2026 statement shows Rp277.9bn of treasury stock, so interim shares_out is null. No rights issues 2020-2026; the last rights issue was in Dec 2010.

SELF-CHECK (split-adjusted to post-split basis). eps x shares_out vs net_profit_attr: 2020 -0.05%, 2021 -0.03%, 2022 +0.11%, 2023 -0.04%, 2024 +0.09%, 2025 -0.06%. dps x FY-end shares_out vs dividend total: 2020 0.00%, 2021 0.00%, 2022 0.00%, 2023 -0.04%, 2024 0.00%, 2025 +0.04%; the 2023 and 2025 gaps come from treasury shares at the record date. net_profit_attr x payout vs total: all within 0.01%. No mismatch above 3%.

MODEL IMPACT (for the page code): the interim is newer than FY2025 and its shares_out is null, so stocks/_lib/model.php will compute no current TTM EPS / BVPS / P/E / P/B for BBNI unless it falls back to fy.2025.shares_out (37,297,312,916). Interim coc, lar, npl_coverage and casa are null, as are deposits and the *_prior balances, so the 'current' versions of those metrics and the loan/deposit growth figures will also be n/a. Replacing the interim with 9M2026 company documents, once they can be retrieved, would fill most of these gaps.

ir_url (https://www.bni.co.id/id-id/perusahaan/hubunganinvestor) follows the path quoted in BNI's own 2018 AGMS material. It could not be opened live because of the bot protection. AR2025: the English file BNI-AR2025-English.pdf was used; a second upload, BNI-AR2025-Inggris.pdf (archived 2026-08-25), exists and was not used.

MINOR DISCREPANCIES: AR2025 NPL coverage 2025 is 205.5% in the table but 206.4% in the MD&A text (table stored). Net NPL 2021 is 0.7 in the ARs but 0.9 in the FY2024 deck (AR stored). AR2023's quarterly price table prints some pre-split 2023 prices off the IDX tick grid (e.g. 9,226); these are irrelevant to the stored Q4 values.
